description: This file defines the TransactionCommitterAttributeMapper class, which implements IAttributeToFactoryMapper for TransactionCommitterAttribute. It maps attributes to factory methods for creating transaction committers within Orleans transactions, utilizing reflection to invoke generic methods.

classes.name: TransactionCommitterAttributeMapper
classes.description: Implements IAttributeToFactoryMapper for TransactionCommitterAttribute, mapping attributes to factory functions for transaction committers.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a factory function based on the provided parameter info and attribute, using reflection to handle generic types.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory method to create a transaction committer instance, using dependency injection and reflection.
